name: The Amani Empire
shortDescription: The forest-troll power whose ancestral northern lands came into conflict with Quel'Thalas and later Arathor.
body: The Amani were an organized forest-troll people with ancestral ties to the northern lands. The founding of Quel'Thalas brought them into conflict with the high elves, and that struggle later drew Arathor into the Troll Wars.
